name: UmaTL + uma.guide skills
description: UmaTL with uma.guide skill translations merged in. Adds 592 skill names and descriptions UmaTL does not yet cover, mostly newer JP-only skills, and uses uma.guide's wording for skills it does. Everything else, including stories, menus, inheritance factors and race commentary, is UmaTL unchanged. All base translations are UmaTL's work; please support them through the links below.
